title: Hom factorization in the canonical finite coefficient diagram
statement: Use [def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set] and [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category]. Let Y be qcqs, ell prime, E a finite coefficient field, P,Q internal E_Y-modules, and P globally finitely presented. Every map P→Res_EOmega(Omega tensor_E Q) factors through Res_EF(F tensor_E Q) for some finite F≥E, with the specified mixedScalarMap as inclusion into the Omega extension. No finite presentation of Q is assumed.

source.place: (Obj) descent paragraph, finite-stage comparisons on pairwise overlaps

proof.text: Use the universe-lifted under-category of E as the filtered index category. Its forgetful functor to finite fields is final. Apply the coefficient-complex colimit theorem to the complex concentrated in degree zero at Q.

Evaluation at degree zero preserves this colimit. Apply the internal finitely presented Hom factorization theorem. The cocone legs in degree zero are definitionally the specified mixedScalarMap inclusions.

theorem condensed_coefficient_hom_stage
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y]
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ)
    (P Q : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) Ab.{u + 1}) (padicSubfieldRingObj Y ℓ E))
    (hP : Mod.IsFinitelyPresented (padicSubfieldRingObj Y ℓ E) P)
    (a : P ⟶ (Mod.comap (padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl Y ℓ E)).obj
      ((Mod.extendScalars (padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl Y ℓ E)).obj Q)) :
    ∃ (F : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ) (hEF : E ≤ F)
      (b : P ⟶ (Mod.comap (padicSubfieldRingObjMap Y ℓ hEF)).obj
        ((Mod.extendScalars (padicSubfieldRingObjMap Y ℓ hEF)).obj Q)),
      b ≫ Mod.mixedScalarMap
        (padicSubfieldRingObjMap Y ℓ hEF) (padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl Y ℓ E)
        (padicSubfieldRingObjMap Y ℓ hEF) (padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl Y ℓ E)
        (padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl Y ℓ F)
        (padicSubfieldRingObjMap_comp_toPadicAlgCl Y ℓ hEF)
        (padicSubfieldRingObjMap_comp_toPadicAlgCl Y ℓ hEF) Q = a
